verdict.rationale: AMD documents Linux x86-64 support for the RX 9070 XT and lists it (gfx1201) in its Linux ROCm framework install guides. AMD also describes ROCm as a primarily open-source stack you can inspect and customize. That supports an open Linux software path, but nothing in the pack says the kernel driver itself is open source or upstream. missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of an open-source kernel module (e.g., amdgpu) or upstream mainline kernel support for this GPU, independent hands-on corroboration of running it on an open driver.
